in_marathi.name: Gokul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gokul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gokul means 'the place where cows are sheltered'. In Hindu mythology, it refers to the birthplace of Lord Krishna and a place of divine love and nurturing.
